gen-fs-styro-gf-noto-sans-lao-looped: Chunky retro swagger, packed tight, from Styro up top. Noto Sans Lao Looped then fills the lines with solid, blocky words, its bowls left open on one side so the text never clogs.
gen-fs-styro-gf-noto-sans-lepcha: Styro crowds its letters together until the e and c nearly seal shut, a retro push of pure command. Noto Sans Lepcha opens its curves wide instead, a sans-serif with tall, sturdy lowercase.
gen-fs-styro-gf-noto-sans-limbu: Styro hits hard, its retro letters packed so tightly the counters almost vanish. But Noto Sans Limbu is a sans-serif that lets its curves gape, with tall small letters doing the quiet work.
gen-fs-styro-gf-noto-sans-lydian: Retro and pressed tight, Styro looks like it's holding its breath. Yet Noto Sans Lydian exhales in a plain sans, with capitals barely above the lowercase and wide, sprung openings that keep a long read easy.
gen-fs-styro-gf-noto-sans-mahajani: Tall lowercase and a funnel-wide throat in the e give Noto Sans Mahajani an unhurried, modern feel. Styro, the retro, tightly packed heading above, hands over to it a plain sans that keeps a long page moving.
gen-fs-styro-gf-noto-sans-malayalam: Styro is retro and commanding, its letters jammed close with barely a gap in the e or c. But Noto Sans Malayalam handles the heavy lifting, a sans-serif whose middle zone dominates and whose s bends open generously.
gen-fs-styro-gf-noto-sans-mandaic: Noto Sans Mandaic is a sans-serif with lowercase rising close to the capitals and curves that feel unclamped. Styro is better at the crowded, retro shout; this one is better at relaxed text.
gen-fs-styro-gf-noto-sans-marchen: Styro presses its retro letters shoulder to shoulder, the e and c nearly shut. And Noto Sans Marchen, a sans-serif with proud, almost capital-sized small letters, lets its curves end in clear daylight beneath.
gen-fs-styro-gf-noto-sans-mayan-numerals: Squeezed-together letters, with barely a gap in the e and c, make Styro unmistakably retro. And Noto Sans Mayan Numerals answers in a plain sans, tall-bodied with a visibly gaping c, built for easy running text.
